description: Header file defining types, constants, and utility functions for managing audio device and format sets in Android's media framework.

methods.name: Intersection
methods.description: Computes the intersection of two sets and returns a vector of common elements.

methods.name: SetIntersection
methods.description: Computes the intersection of two sets and returns a set of common elements.

methods.name: asInMask
methods.description: Converts a set of output channel masks to input channel masks.

methods.name: asOutMask
methods.description: Converts a set of input channel masks to output channel masks.

methods.name: isSingleDeviceType
methods.description: Checks if device types set contains exactly one specific device type.

methods.name: isSingleDeviceType (predicate version)
methods.description: Checks if device types set contains exactly one device type satisfying a predicate.

methods.name: areAllOfSameDeviceType
methods.description: Checks if all device types in the set satisfy a given predicate.

methods.name: resetDeviceTypes
methods.description: Resets device types set to contain only a specified device type.

methods.name: deviceTypesToBitMask
methods.description: Converts a set of device types to a bitmask representation.
